primary_endpoint: Change in MRI-PDFF from baseline to Weeks 24 and 12 in the per-protocol population.
efficacy_outcome: At Week 24, change was 0.38 (5 mg), -0.44 (10 mg), and -3.09 (placebo); reported p-values were 0.034 and 0.1731. At Week 12, changes were -1.78, -1.50, and -2.74, respectively; p-values were 0.5276 and 0.4968.
safety_signal: Serious AEs occurred in 1/21 participants receiving 5 mg, 1/22 receiving 10 mg, and 0/22 receiving placebo; no deaths.
